notes: Built from ep021.ts lines: only CAPITALS added; words identical to say. Clear and unhurried, punch only on the key line.
persona: You are a clear, unhurried YouTube science narrator talking straight to one friend who is standing somewhere impossible. Conversational, warm and curious, an easy pace with short natural pauses between sentences, no audible breaths. Extra punch only on the key line of each beat. Words in CAPITALS get extra emphasis. Each line starts with a direction in parentheses: follow it, but never read the directions aloud.

lines.style: clear and gripping, a hushed shock
lines.tagged: You step onto VENUS. You have sixty SECONDS.

lines.style: calm and steady, a little ominous
lines.tagged: It's four hundred and sixty-four DEGREES. Hot enough to melt LEAD.
The air is so HEAVY, it feels like standing nine hundred metres under the SEA.
Above you, the clouds are made of sulfuric ACID.

lines.style: the key line: big, clear punch, then a heavy pause
lines.tagged: That's why every visitor so far has been a ROBOT, never a PERSON.
And even robots give up FAST.

lines.style: leaning in, amazed, sharing a true fact
lines.tagged: In nineteen eighty-two, the Soviet probe Venera thirteen was built to last thirty-two MINUTES. It kept working for one hundred and twenty-SEVEN.
Nearly FOUR times longer, on the HOTTEST planet there is.
What should you survive next? The BEST comment becomes the next video.
